pitti_panel.root_cause: Season weekly refresh requests broad FantasyPros consensus-rankings only and never supplies selected expert filters/identity binding. Existing live selected-panel ingestion is draft/preseason week=0/type=DRAFT infrastructure, so broad weekly ECR cannot become the selected PITTI panel without fabricating expert votes.
pitti_panel.external_evidence: FantasyPros API documents consensus-rankings filters as a whitelist of expert IDs and exposes rankings/experts; current Week 2 public expert pages/directories show individual weekly rankings are published.
pitti_panel.bounded_repair: Add current-week selected-expert acquisition using exact FantasyPros expert IDs, explicit week/position/HALF context, experts=show/filter binding, freshness/coverage checks, and fail-closed per-position panel construction. Never substitute broad ECR for missing selected experts.

canonical_game_context.root_cause: Production Worker reaches the canonical ESPN scoreboard request but receives upstream HTTP 403. Physical evidence proves the app/worker failure-provenance contract is correct; parser/mapping is not the blocking defect.
canonical_game_context.external_evidence: Public ESPN endpoint references document the same weekly scoreboard family; recent third-party Week 2 evidence cites an ESPN site.web.api scoreboard variant. Any fallback must be proven from the Cloudflare runtime before promotion.
canonical_game_context.bounded_repair: Test a narrowly allowlisted ESPN-hosted fallback/headers strategy in non-production first, require exact season/week and complete unique 32-team/16-game-or-bye-safe schedule validation, preserve sanitized failure provenance, and fail closed on disagreement or partial coverage.

team_total.root_cause: game-context-v1 already contains impliedTeamTotal(total,spread,...) but no runtime lane acquires a verified same-event total+spread pair; games are hard-coded vegas=UNAVAILABLE/NO_APPROVED_ROBUST_SOURCE.
team_total.external_evidence: Public ESPN core odds examples expose event-scoped overUnder and spread fields. That is a candidate source only, not yet approved or Cloudflare-proven for PITTI.
team_total.bounded_repair: Only after schedule/event IDs are reliably available, validate one approved ESPN odds provider policy, same-event total+spread, timestamp/freshness and side orientation, then call the existing impliedTeamTotal helper. No synthetic totals from projections.

weather_opponent.root_cause: Opponent, kickoff, venue/roof and event weather depend on complete canonical game-context events. Upstream schedule 403 therefore blocks the lane. Weather additionally remains fail-closed unless a fresh event-bound forecast is present.
weather_opponent.bounded_repair: Restore verified game context first; retain existing fresh-event weather requirements and no-weather-needed dome semantics.
